import importlib.util
import json
import os
import pathlib
import unittest
import psycopg

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("consumer", root / "worker/consume.py")
consumer = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(consumer)

class WorkerTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_transaction_and_redelivery(self):
        with psycopg.connect(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"], autocommit=True) as connection:
            with connection.transaction():
                connection.execute("CREATE TEMP TABLE orders(id text PRIMARY KEY, total_cents integer NOT NULL CHECK(total_cents > 0))")
                connection.execute("CREATE TEMP TABLE processed_events(event_id text PRIMARY KEY)")
            messages = json.loads((root / "evidence/messages.json").read_text())
            self.assertEqual([consumer.process(json.dumps(m), connection) for m in messages], ["committed", "committed", "duplicate"])
            self.assertEqual(connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM orders").fetchone()[0], 2)
            conflict = {"version":2,"event_id":"event-failed","order_id":"order-1","amount_cents":300}
            with self.assertRaises(psycopg.errors.UniqueViolation):
                consumer.process(json.dumps(conflict), connection)
            self.assertEqual(connection.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM processed_events WHERE event_id='event-failed'").fetchone()[0], 0)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                consumer.process(json.dumps({"version":3}), connection)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
